title: MINOS v2 Learning Profile (localStorage) Schema
description: Schema for the user learning profile persisted in localStorage by learning-engine.js. Reflects the contract: { version, modeWeights, topicAffinities, sourceTrust, updated }. All fields optional; engine degrades gracefully when empty. NO PII is ever stored — only mode/topic/source signals.

version.description: Schema version. Bump on breaking changes.

modeWeights.description: Raw usage-driven scores keyed by mode id (deep-study, sunday-message, sermon-notes, whatsapp-devotional, facebook-posts, partner-devotional, prayer-guide, morning-brief). Value = cumulative decayed bump count (>0).

topicAffinities.description: Keyed by topic slug (library category OR free-form topic string). Value = cumulative decayed bump count (>0).

sourceTrust.description: Keyed by source/library category (sermon, notes, whatsapp, facebook, partner, prayer, study, other) or explicit source string. Value = trust score (>0 trusted, may be 0 after negative feedback).

interactionCount.description: Total interactions recorded. Recommendations 'warm up' once >= 10.

updated.description: Epoch ms of the last write (Date.now()).
